title: Private Patio/Broadway/Music Row/Hospital-1
description:
Experience the city of Nashville at our Hillsboro Village retreat! This unit harmonizes classic allure with contemporary vibes. Walk to local eateries, bars, the hospital, and renowned music studios, all within a mile. Free parking adds convenience to your stay, placing you at the core of the city's musical legacy. Sleep up to 10 guests.

* 1.8 miles from downtown Nashville
* 0.8 miles from Vanderbilt Hospital
* 4.2 miles from Nissan Stadium
* 1.5 miles from The Gulch

The space
KEY FEATURES:
o Sleeps 10; 3 bedrooms, 4 queen beds, 1 sleeper sofa
o 2 full bath, 1 with tub shower and 1 with standing shower equipped with glass door
o Well equipped kitchen
o High speed WiFi with free YouTube TV. Streaming services available with your login information

Here Are A Few Kind Words From Past Guests:

o “Perfect location near campus!” -Laura
o “We enjoyed our stay at Brianna’s place! Great size for a group of girls!” – Caroline
o “Perfect house to host 10 girls for a long weekend! Lots of restaurants and shops near by to walk to and broadway was a short Uber away! Thanks Brianna! I would stay here again :)” -Chrissy

**BEDROOMS**

The 3 bedrooms are equipped with a comfortable queen sized beds as well as plenty of storage space.

**BATHROOMs**

There are two full bathrooms in the unit fully stocked with all of the toiletries that you need in case you don’t want to bring your own.

Please feel free to use our washer and dryer located in the unit. Make sure to bring your own detergent!

**KITCHEN**

The bright and airy kitchen is fully equipped with appliances, cookware and utensils you need to feel at home.

**OUTSIDE SPACE**

A private patio beckons right outside of the 2nd living room. Enjoy a few games and creating memories on the deck area!

***Book Today & Let Us Take Care Of You In Nashville***

Guest access
Self-check-in with keyless electric lock codes, to ensure safety for all guests. Full access to the entire unit, no shared spaces within the unit. Guests will also have access to 3 free parking spaces in front of the building. Additional street parking in front of the building is free on the weekends.

Other things to note
Please be sure to review the additional house rules listed at the bottom of this page for important information and requirements related to booking this property.
